# Self-hosted WebLLM runtime attribution

This standalone module is an esbuild 0.25.11 minification of `@mlc-ai/web-llm` 0.2.85 and resolved `loglevel` 1.9.2, prepared by the disposable Phase 1 trial. Its exact byte digest is in `sources.json`. The module's behavior is unchanged; the modifications are bundling and minification for local hosting. It contains no retained legal-comment block. The notices below are therefore distributed separately with the module.

- WebLLM and its included MLC runtime/tokenizer/grammar code: Apache 2.0, reproduced in `WebLLM-APACHE-2.0.txt`. The npm package declares Apache 2.0 and bundles the MLC components into `lib/index.js`.
- loglevel: Copyright (c) 2013 Tim Perry, MIT. The full notice is in `loglevel-MIT.txt`.
- tslib, including helper copies embedded inside WebRuntime and WebTokenizers: Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation, ISC. `tslib-ISC.txt` copies the exact complete permission/disclaimer block recovered from the pinned WebLLM source map.
- Apache TVM / WebRuntime: Apache 2.0. `Apache-TVM-NOTICE.txt` preserves the Apache TVM notice supplied in the declared `@mlc-ai/web-runtime` 0.27.0-dev0 npm distribution: Copyright 2019–2023 The Apache Software Foundation; includes software developed at the Apache Software Foundation. The embedded WebRuntime source also contains the ASF Apache licensing header.

WebLLM's source map identifies embedded `@mlc-ai/web-runtime`, `@mlc-ai/web-tokenizers`, `@mlc-ai/web-xgrammar`, tslib and loglevel. Source hashes are retained in `sources.json`. The source map does not record exact nested package versions; WebLLM's package manifest declares WebRuntime `^0.27.0-dev0`, WebTokenizers `^0.1.6` and WebXGrammar `0.1.27`. These are **declared build dependencies**, not independently verified embedded version pins. The inspected declared npm distributions identify the three MLC components as Apache 2.0. Reproduction uses the already built, integrity-pinned WebLLM 0.2.85 npm artifact, rather than rebuilding those dependency ranges against current releases.

Primary sources: [WebLLM](https://github.com/mlc-ai/web-llm), [Apache TVM](https://github.com/apache/tvm), [tokenizers-cpp](https://github.com/mlc-ai/tokenizers-cpp), [XGrammar](https://github.com/mlc-ai/xgrammar), [loglevel](https://github.com/pimterry/loglevel), and the `lib/index.js.map` included in the pinned WebLLM npm package. This metadata covers the observed JavaScript bundle components; it does not claim a new independent audit of all Rust/C++ dependencies compiled into upstream WASM or authorize model-weight redistribution.
